subject.title: fix(browser): preserve lazy tool output schema

question: Is the reported test and CI evidence adequate for this internal Browser descriptor repair, or should this PR include a redacted terminal transcript or runtime artifact showing schema discovery and lazy loading after the change?
rationale: The code change is narrow and appears correct, but the supplied PR material does not include inspectable real-behavior evidence; the protected `maintainer` label also requires explicit human handling rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Request redacted runtime evidence
options.body: Ask for a terminal transcript or artifact that shows the registered tool's result schema and confirms Browser runtime loading starts only when the tool executes.

options.title: Accept existing validation
options.body: Treat the focused regression plus successful repository checks as adequate evidence for this low-scope descriptor-contract repair.

recommendation.title: Request redacted runtime evidence
recommendation.body: Ask for a terminal transcript or artifact that shows the registered tool's result schema and confirms Browser runtime loading starts only when the tool executes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this person directly to the Browser registration change, though broader ownership could not be confirmed from local history.
